name: stayupdated
description: StayUpdated: run the backend and frontend together

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
